title: John Harbaugh, Joe Schoen: Giants will continue to address the defensive tackle position

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh, Joe Schoen: Giants will continue to address the defensive tackle position
sources.description: The Giants traded away their best defensive tackle when they sent Dexter Lawrence to Cincinnati, but they're confident they'll be in good shape in the middle of their defensive line when the season starts.
